protocol.session_isolation: one subprocess per (cell, path, session), own fresh TRITON_CACHE_DIR; spawn order randomized per session (seed + record in sessions[].spawn_order)
protocol.segments: context (module import -> device context ready), setup (path construction; entry paths include table load + plan_fft, sub-timed as plan_fft_ms), warm probes on scratch (vendor_plan_probe / stage_plan_probe / triton_jit_probe / entry_kernel_probe / m0_kernel_probe — itemized, cover torch plan creation, triton JIT and entry kernels in a fresh process), first_call (first execution on the real input in plan-reuse state), steady (warmup=5 rounds=5 trials=32 raw trials)
protocol.one_shot: reconstructed: setup_ms + warm_probe_total_ms + first_call_ms (one_shot_with_context_ms adds context_ms); an unsegmented fresh-process one-shot would pay these serially inside its first call; reported descriptively, NOT gated
protocol.warm: plan-reuse steady state: warmup=5 rounds=5 trials=32
protocol.bootstrap: independent bootstrap, B=2000, seed=102026: candidate and reference warm trial arrays resampled independently (not paired), percentile 95% CI
protocol.gate: steady-state plan-reuse only; eligible_for_selector requires (every session) all_paths_present AND no_fail_closed AND correct_all_sessions AND contract_all_sessions AND independent-bootstrap CI lower bound > 1.02 vs vendor AND vs the profile-bound incumbent_entry, every session; one-shot ratios and m0_reference reported separately
protocol.input_semantics: complex64 non-zero imag, contiguous (B,N), axis=-1, norm=backward (fwd unscaled, inv 1/N); b==1 entry paths measured as the 1-D (N,) production contract; input seeded per (session, n, b) and identical for all five paths
protocol.incumbent: PROFILE-BOUND deployed selector path: plan_fft(direction='dit', profile_hash=table['profile_hash'], env_hash='auto', table=config/selector_table.json) + execute_fft_plan on this run's sessions/segments; per-row record of selection_source, entry_tier (previous-fallback), executed, flow_id/flow_realization/processing_unit, plan_reason; an abstain/fallback plan fails the row closed as 'profile-bound incumbent no-go' (cell ineligible), never silently replaced by M0
protocol.m0_reference: m0_reference path: plan_fft(profile_hash=None) abstains to M0 by the selector contract; recorded as speedup_m0_reference_boot / one_shot_ratio_m0 for descriptive comparison only — NOT the deployed incumbent, never a gate input

selector_wiring.note: eligible_for_selector means the promotion evidence threshold is met for the listed cells; PR #12 is evidence-only and does not touch config/selector_table.json or src/xpu/selector.py. Runtime wiring lands in a separate integration PR (see selector_diff.json).

eligibility.stats_method: independent bootstrap, B=2000, seed=102026: candidate and reference warm trial arrays resampled independently (not paired)
eligibility.gate: steady-state plan-reuse only: eligible_for_selector requires (every session) all_paths_present AND no_fail_closed AND correct_all_sessions (rel_err <= 1e-4) AND contract_all_sessions AND bootstrap CI lower bound of speedup > 1.02 vs vendor AND vs the PROFILE-BOUND deployed incumbent_entry (table profile_hash + env_hash=auto); a profile-bound abstain/fallback is a cell no-go; one-shot ratios (one_shot_ratio_*) and the m0_reference are reported separately and NOT gated

cell_field_definitions.all_paths_present: every path row exists in every session
cell_field_definitions.no_fail_closed: no path row failed closed in any session (includes profile-bound incumbent no-go)
cell_field_definitions.correct_all_sessions: every path correct in every session
cell_field_definitions.contract_all_sessions: selector-grade input contract present in every session

eligibility.release_quality_status: PARTIAL: validated cells listed, rest of matrix still exploratory
eligibility.incumbent_policy: the hard gate uses incumbent_entry = the PROFILE-BOUND deployed selector (plan_fft(profile_hash=table[profile_hash], env_hash=auto) + execute_fft_plan) measured in this run's sessions; selection_source/entry_tier/executed/flow are recorded per row; m0_reference (profile_hash=None -> M0 abstain) is a descriptive baseline only and never a gate
eligibility.issue9_policy: issue9 v61 e2e values (incl. its historical selector:e2e) are descriptive_issue9_reference only (different warmup/rounds machinery); the hard incumbent gate is the profile-bound incumbent_entry measured in this run
eligibility.batched_boundary: B>1 eligibility is entry-level contract evidence (plan_fft(batch=b)+execute_fft_plan -> fft_*_batch / _validate_batch_input, run_fft rank-2); the public validate_input helper remains the 1-D single-length contract — a full public-batched helper sync is a separate contract PR before selector integration
